classification_rationale: The customer is proposing a specific ongoing discount based on loyalty and volume, a pricing concession that requires a commercial judgment call rather than a policy lookup.

draft.reply_body:
Hello,

Thank you for your loyalty over the years, and for raising this. A 22% ongoing discount isn't something we're able to offer, though — it's above the maximum discretionary discount available anywhere in the company, which is capped at 15% and needs Regional Manager approval even at that level.

Given the volume of business on your account, I'd like to pass this on to our management team to see what can be arranged within that limit. I'll come back to you once I've heard from them.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy

commitments.description: Declined the requested 22% ongoing discount as it exceeds the maximum discretionary discount authority anywhere in the company (15%)
Will refer the discount request to management for consideration within the available limit
